subject: Scheduling: Technical deep dive (60-90m) — Skyline AI / Redwood
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Chang <alex@skyline.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@skyline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Technical deep dive (60-90m) — Skyline AI / Redwood

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap: Skyline is focused on reducing per-request latency for contextual search (avg seq len ~512) and securing inference for PII-sensitive logs. You mentioned wanting a hands-on technical runthrough with your infra/ML team to validate integration patterns and performance expectations.

Proposal: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (TDX) where we:
- Walk the requested integration patterns (RDW-hosted API + private deployment options)
- Share latency/cost expectations with representative traffic shape
- Live Q&A and a short runthrough of our infra concerns (networking, KMS, audit logs)

Available windows (PDT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:30
- Tue May 25, 14:00–15:30
- Wed May 26, 09:00–10:30

Can you confirm which window works and who from your side will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security)? Also helpful if you can share any must-cover items so we can tailor the agenda.

Attached: proposed agenda and a short prep checklist. If you want, we can extend to 90 minutes for a short performance demo.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf, tdx-prep-checklist.md

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap. Both windows on Tue May 25 are promising; 14:00–15:30 PDT would be ideal for our team. Attendees on our side:
- Alex Chang (Product Lead)
- Priya Shah (Infra/Cloud)
- Daniel Ortiz (ML Platform) — may need to hop off after 45m
- Nisha Patel (Security) — will join for the first 30–45m to cover compliance questions

Must-cover items:
- Network topology for Private deployment (VPC peering vs. private connect)
- KMS integration flow and key rotation impact on performance
- Live token-level cost breakdown for a sample workload (we'll send traffic profile)

Also: we have a short compliance questionnaire — can you include the one-pager on audit logs + retention?

If 14:00 PDT is confirmed, please send the calendar invite and any pre-reads.

Best,
Alex
